_role: The blind adversarial seat required by publish_bar.py clause 6. A seat that saw the authoring context is not independent evidence, and a seat that reviewed a different tree is not a review of this one.
_blind_means: Each seat was given the file paths and the pinned sha and nothing else — no authorship, no history, no statement of what the programme wants the answer to be, and no sight of the other seat's work. Both were instructed to refute by default.
seat: two blind seats — hostile-referee and prose-artifact-regression
_verdict_note: ⛔ BOTH SEATS RETURNED not_supported, so clause 6 FAILS on this commit and the paper cannot post — which is correct and is the gate working. ⭐ THEY CONVERGED INDEPENDENTLY ON THREE BLOCKERS without seeing each other: the Abstract's pool count, the Abstract's unbounded 'has ever been reported', and the Paioli 2021 multivariable attribution. Convergence between different lenses is the strongest signal this arrangement produces. ⭐⭐ AND WHAT NEITHER COULD BREAK IS THE MORE USEFUL HALF: between them they re-derived every Fisher p-value, every Wilson interval and every pool sum from the raw integers with their own implementations, and confirmed the generator reproduces the artifact byte-for-byte. Zero arithmetic mismatches. Every single blocker is REPORTING DRIFT — the document and the machine-readable thing beside it disagreeing, or a correction that reached one copy of a claim and not another — except HR-B4, which is selective reporting.
central_claim: Across the small published EMC record this repository happens to hold, the NR4A3 5' fusion partner separates two crude, unadjusted quantities and nothing more. (1) PROGNOSIS: pooling the two pathology series that print per-partner event counts (Agaram 2014 n=23, Huang 2023 n=50; 73 patients) gives crude during-follow-up disease-specific death of 7/15 with TAF15::NR4A3 against 6/58 with EWSR1::NR4A3 - a descriptive contrast that the larger contributing cohort's own multivariable model attributes to tumour size rather than to the partner. (2) RESPONSE: three to five TAF15 patients have received an antiangiogenic TKI in the sources examined and none is recorded as responding, which is a direction with no magnitude, since the Wilson upper bound on the TAF15 rate lies above the comparator arm's own point estimate in both analyses. (3) PREVALENCE: 28/154 = 18.2% of partner-assigned EMC across four series. Every count is a crude proportion with a Wilson interval; no adjusted, time-to-event or predictive quantity is estimated anywhere, and none of the counts is read from a primary TKI report - both response cohorts' per-arm denominators come from reviews.
scope_note: No measurement was refuted. This programme's history records that six of eight refutations upheld the measurement and killed the inference drawn from it, and that pattern holds again: the arithmetic stands and the reporting around it did not. ⛔ ONE EXCEPTION IN KIND, NOT IN SEVERITY: HR-B4 is not drift at all. Two partner-stratified sources were absent from a table this paper calls 'the full inclusion table' and BOTH cut toward the null the headline argues against — an undisclosed exclusion that weakens the author's own claim, which is the most serious class of defect available to a synthesis and the one no amount of arithmetic checking would have found.

seats.basis: Found the one defect the other seat did not, and it is the worst one: two null-leaning partner-stratified sources absent from the inclusion table, one of them sitting in this paper's own companion with an unactioned item to include it.

blockers.why_it_blocks: A synthesis that publishes an inclusion/exclusion table and calls it 'the full inclusion table' must show every candidate it refused, especially the ones it refused on contestable grounds and especially the ones whose data run against its own result. Here the two that are invisible are precisely the two that push the headline toward the null - one whose TAF15 arm has zero disease-specific deaths, one that tested OS by partner and found nothing. Both exclusions may well be defensible (s2.1(3) for Sjogren; MSKCC population overlap and no per-partner event counts for Suemitsu). The defect is not the exclusion, it is that the reader is never told either exists, while being told the table is complete. That is selective reporting on the face of the document, and it is the first thing a rival group holding those two papers will say.

It asserts exhaustiveness over the published literature from a synthesis that, by its own §2.3a, queried no database, ran no screening flow and used no second reader — and the paper's own machine-readable artifact says in capitals that the claim must never be phrased that way.
